newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA BEAT WEST INDIES, WIN SERIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA BEAT WEST INDIES, WIN SERIES.

text.p: Australia won their fourth test against the West Indies by an innings and 183 runs before lunch on the fourth day at the Adelaide Oval on Tuesday, delivering a three-one series victory.
West Indies second innings - 204 all out. (Brian Lara 78, Michael Bevan six for 82).
Australia first innings - 517 all out from 162.3 overs (Overnight 434 for five) - (Matthew Hayden 125, Mark Waugh 82, Greg Blewett 99, Michael Bevan 85 not out).
West Indies first innings - 130 in 47.5 overs (Michael Bevan four for 31, Shane Warne three for 42.)
